consumer_slices.label: sliceId
consumer_slices.rule: Extension shard for new consumer-related slice metadata; canonical slice IDs and keys must remain mirrored through the SSOT gate before use.

consumer_api_contracts.label: owner
consumer_api_contracts.rule: Extension shard for consumer source API contracts; canonical owners and public contract fields remain mirrored through source_api_contracts before use.

consumer_state_schema.label: schemaName
consumer_state_schema.rule: Extension shard for consumer source state schemas; canonical schema names and fields remain mirrored through source_state_schema before use.

consumer_symbols.label: symbol
consumer_symbols.rule: Extension shard for consumer source symbols; canonical symbol entries and mirrored fields remain sourced from source_symbol_registry before use.

bullet_slices.label: sliceId
bullet_slices.rule: Extension shard for bullet source slice metadata; canonical slice IDs are selected from source_slice_ledger java_source paths under /entities/bullet/ and mirrored through the SSOT gate before use.

bullet_api_contracts.label: owner
bullet_api_contracts.rule: Extension shard for bullet source API contracts; canonical owners come from bullet_slices.godot_owner and public contract fields remain mirrored through source_api_contracts before use.

bullet_state_schema.label: schemaName
bullet_state_schema.rule: Extension shard for bullet source state schemas; schema names are derived from bullet_api_contracts params and existing canonical result schemas, then mirrored through source_state_schema before use.

bullet_symbols.label: symbol
bullet_symbols.rule: Extension shard for bullet source symbols; canonical symbol names come from bullet_slices.source_symbols and mirrored fields remain sourced from source_symbol_registry before use.

power_slices.label: sliceId
power_slices.rule: Extension shard for power-block slice metadata; canonical slice IDs are selected from source_slice_ledger java_source paths under /world/blocks/power/ and mirrored through the SSOT gate before use.

power_api_contracts.label: owner
power_api_contracts.rule: Extension shard for power-block source API contracts; canonical owners come from power_slices.godot_owner and public contract fields remain mirrored through source_api_contracts before use.

power_state_schema.label: schemaName
power_state_schema.rule: Extension shard for power-block source state schemas; schema names are derived from power_api_contracts params and existing canonical result schemas, then mirrored through source_state_schema before use.

power_symbols.label: symbol
power_symbols.rule: Extension shard for power-block source symbols; canonical symbol names come from power_slices.source_symbols and mirrored fields remain sourced from source_symbol_registry before use.
